subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining scope stop at documenting the upstream multiline editor behavior, or should OpenClaw introduce a persistent user-configurable send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: The base editor already owns the key decoding, while a new OpenClaw config or CLI bridge would create a public compatibility surface whose defaults, supported shortcuts, and terminal fallbacks require maintainer intent.

options.title: Document the existing behavior
options.body: Add concise TUI help and docs for Shift+Enter plus the supported fallback, without adding a new configuration surface.

options.title: Sponsor a configurable contract
options.body: Define a stable OpenClaw preference for send versus newline behavior, including terminal limits, defaults, upgrade behavior, and focused tests.

recommendation.title: Document the existing behavior
recommendation.body: Add concise TUI help and docs for Shift+Enter plus the supported fallback, without adding a new configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review and feature history connect this person to the current TUI wrapper and the earlier maintainer scoping of this issue.
